tldr: The invoice API, eleven calculators, Redbubble designs and Payhip’s $5 pack have public pages, but no sales are reported. Payhip checkout is disabled; calculators now link to Buy Me a Coffee, which still cannot take support. Redbubble’s camper design now has a public product page, but its shop grid is still empty; TeePublic publishing is parked after repeated crashes. All three Legiit services now show ACTIVE with no pending-approval label: retro art ($15), calculator ($20) and invoice generator ($25). Legiit marketplace discovery and buyer checkout are unverified. Stripe and GitHub Sponsors are building; Adobe and Etsy are blocked; Fiverr and Truelancer are parked. HackerOne and Bugcrowd account setup is complete; security bounty research is building, with no reports or awards yet.
